# Dataset inventory

<!-- Generated by `npm run qb:report` from canonical sources. Do not edit by hand. -->

Each Learn or Practice run loads its one canonical dataset. Both surfaces share the same schema and data; no edition or size selection is required. Frozen tools retain their separate compatibility fixtures.

## Retail (`retail`)

Two years of real invoice lines from a UK online gift wholesaler: customers, products, sales, cancellations and returns, with modeled payments and customer segment history.

- Role framing: Retail analyst
- Questions: 107 (Warm-up 24, Easy 31, Medium 31, Hard 21)
- Topics: SQL basics, Filtering, Joins, Subqueries & CTEs, Aggregation, Query optimization, Business analytics, Database engineering, Data warehousing, Window functions, Strings & data cleaning, Dates & time
- Lessons: 0, 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 2, 54, 14, 15, 16, 17, 31, 55, 28, 29, 59, 62, 66, 69, 70, 71, 72, 73, 74, 76, 77, 78, 79, 80, 81, 82, 83, 84, 85, 86, 87

- `seasons` (10 rows): season INTEGER PK NOT NULL, first_game_date TEXT NOT NULL, last_regular_date TEXT NOT NULL, games_per_team INTEGER NOT NULL, postseason_teams INTEGER NOT NULL
- `games` (23168 rows): game_id TEXT PK NOT NULL, season INTEGER NOT NULL, game_date TEXT NOT NULL, game_number INTEGER NOT NULL, game_type TEXT NOT NULL, venue_id TEXT NOT NULL, home_team_id TEXT NOT NULL, away_team_id TEXT NOT NULL, home_score INTEGER NOT NULL, away_score INTEGER NOT NULL, day_night TEXT, attendance INTEGER, duration_minutes INTEGER · FK season → seasons(season), venue_id → venues(venue_id), home_team_id → teams(team_id), away_team_id → teams(team_id)
- `players` (1471 rows): player_id TEXT PK NOT NULL, first_name TEXT NOT NULL, last_name TEXT NOT NULL, bats TEXT, throws TEXT, primary_position TEXT, birth_date TEXT, birth_country TEXT, debut_date TEXT
- `player_game_stats` (73029 rows): game_id TEXT PK NOT NULL, player_id TEXT PK NOT NULL, team_id TEXT NOT NULL, batting_order INTEGER, started INTEGER NOT NULL, plate_appearances INTEGER NOT NULL, at_bats INTEGER NOT NULL, runs INTEGER NOT NULL, hits INTEGER NOT NULL, doubles INTEGER NOT NULL, triples INTEGER NOT NULL, home_runs INTEGER NOT NULL, rbi INTEGER NOT NULL, walks INTEGER NOT NULL, strikeouts INTEGER NOT NULL, stolen_bases INTEGER NOT NULL, hit_by_pitch INTEGER NOT NULL · FK game_id → games(game_id), player_id → players(player_id), team_id → teams(team_id)
- `standings` (2010 rows): season INTEGER PK NOT NULL, as_of_date TEXT PK NOT NULL, team_id TEXT PK NOT NULL, wins INTEGER NOT NULL, losses INTEGER NOT NULL, runs_scored INTEGER NOT NULL, runs_allowed INTEGER NOT NULL · FK season → seasons(season), team_id → teams(team_id)

## Canonical data contract

Learn and Practice share 12 canonical identities and one physical snapshot per domain. Source and license documentation, schema grain, counts and reproducible-build details live in `docs/sql-phase1/DATASETS.md`.

Operational source groups retain separate keys. For example, Retail's observed invoices and modeled online-shop order lines do not share customer identities. Join only declared relationships. Raw ingestion tables intentionally retain invalid source records for cleaning exercises; curated foreign keys remain valid.

Sports includes scheduled games, cancelled games, draws, team roles, player appearances, unused squad members and club-training bookings. Its data is deterministic and wholly fictional.

The old tools and projects retain compatibility fixtures for a later review. Their physical artifact choices are not part of the Learn/Practice UI.
